# Hoceine El Idrissi

> Freelance Laravel & Filament developer based in Morocco. Builds web platforms with Laravel (Livewire, Filament, Inertia with React or Vue), installable web apps (PWAs), and Filament admin panels and plugins. Many products are Arabic-first with full right-to-left support. Available for freelance and contract work: contact@hoceine.com

## Selected work

- [FilamentCraft](https://hoceine.com/projects/filamentcraft): Commercial Shopify-style visual website builder for Filament 4 and 5 (2026, founder).
- [WiserPocket](https://hoceine.com/projects/wiserpocket): AI finance tracker with voice and receipt input (2025).
- [Mediano](https://hoceine.com/projects/mediano): Multi-tenant sports academy management, 3,400+ commits since 2024 (2024).
- [SmartShop](https://hoceine.com/projects/smartshop): Multi-vendor e-commerce platform with payments, shipping and point of sale (2024).
- [Adiaf](https://hoceine.com/projects/adiaf): Hajj operations platform with six role-based panels, built for Ashraqat Company (2024).
- [Nokhbat Alhoffaz](https://hoceine.com/projects/nokhbat-alhoffaz): Installable app for Quran memorisation and book-reading circles with voice recitations (2026).
- [DecorCopilot](https://hoceine.com/projects/decorcopilot): AI interior design with Google Gemini (2024).
- [All projects](https://hoceine.com/projects)
